notes: You are allowed to take up space.
One hard week is not the whole semester.
Drink some water and text a friend back.
It's okay to ask for help before it gets big.
Somebody in your class is glad you're there.

Go outside for five minutes. Really.
You don't have to have it figured out yet.
Proud of you for getting out of bed today.
